name: ex_lisp.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================


; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

; Note: Tuples are generated as concrete types when used


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatype TopLevelDeclarations ((mk-TopLevelDeclarations (myList Ref))))
(declare-datatype S_Exp ((mk-S_Exp (text String))))
(declare-datatype Atom ((mk-Atom (text String))))
(declare-datatype ListExp ((mk-ListExp (text String)(leftExp Ref)(rightExp Ref))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatype Any (
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-S_Exp (sel-S_Exp S_Exp))
  (lift-Atom (sel-Atom Atom))
  (lift-ListExp (sel-ListExp ListExp))
  (null)
))

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-S_Exp ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-S_Exp (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-S_Exp ((this Ref)) S_Exp
  (sel-S_Exp (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Atom ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Atom (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Atom ((this Ref)) Atom
  (sel-Atom (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-ListExp ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-ListExp (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-ListExp ((this Ref)) ListExp
  (sel-ListExp (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-S_Exp ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-S_Exp this)
    (deref-is-Atom this)
    (deref-is-ListExp this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Atom ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Atom this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-ListExp ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-ListExp this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.myList: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!myList ((this Ref)) Ref
  (myList (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ----------------------------
;   Getters for class S_Exp:
; ----------------------------

; --- getters for S_Exp.text: ---

(define-fun S_Exp.text ((this Ref)) String
  (ite (deref-is-S_Exp this) (text (deref-S_Exp this))
  (ite (deref-is-Atom this) (text (deref-Atom this))
  (text (deref-ListExp this))))
)

; ---------------------------
;   Getters for class Atom:
; ---------------------------

; --- getters for Atom.text: ---

(define-fun Atom!text ((this Ref)) String
  (text (deref-Atom this))
)

; ------------------------------
;   Getters for class ListExp:
; ------------------------------

; --- getters for ListExp.text: ---

(define-fun ListExp.text ((this Ref)) String
  (text (deref-ListExp this))
)

(define-fun ListExp!text ((this Ref)) String
  (text (deref-ListExp this))
)

; --- getters for ListExp.leftExp: ---

(define-fun ListExp!leftExp ((this Ref)) Ref
  (leftExp (deref-ListExp this))
)

; --- getters for ListExp.rightExp: ---

(define-fun ListExp!rightExp ((this Ref)) Ref
  (rightExp (deref-ListExp this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-ListExp (TopLevelDeclarations!myList this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (ListExp.text (TopLevelDeclarations!myList this)) "(A.B)")
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 0) :named _xkassert1))



; ------------------------------
;   Invariant for class S_Exp:
; ------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-S_Exp S_Exp)
(declare-const const-2-S_Exp S_Exp)



; -----------------------------
;   Invariant for class Atom:
; -----------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-3-Atom Atom)
(declare-const const-4-Atom Atom)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun Atom.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (and (and (not (str.contains (Atom!text this) "(")) (not (str.contains (Atom!text this) ")"))) (not (str.contains (Atom!text this) ".")))
)

(assert (! (Atom.inv1 3) :named _xkassert2))
(assert (! (Atom.inv1 4) :named _xkassert3))



; --------------------------------
;   Invariant for class ListExp:
; --------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-5-ListExp ListExp)
(declare-const const-6-ListExp ListExp)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun ListExp.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-S_Exp (ListExp!leftExp this))
)

(assert (! (ListExp.inv1 5) :named _xkassert4))
(assert (! (ListExp.inv1 6) :named _xkassert5))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun ListExp.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-S_Exp (ListExp!rightExp this))
)

(assert (! (ListExp.inv2 5) :named _xkassert6))
(assert (! (ListExp.inv2 6) :named _xkassert7))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun ListExp.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (ListExp!text this) (str.++ (str.++ (str.++ (str.++ "(" (S_Exp.text (ListExp!leftExp this))) ".") (S_Exp.text (ListExp!rightExp this))) ")"))
)

(assert (! (ListExp.inv3 5) :named _xkassert8))
(assert (! (ListExp.inv3 6) :named _xkassert9))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun ListExp.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or (deref-isa-Atom (ListExp!leftExp this)) (deref-isa-ListExp (ListExp!leftExp this)))
)

(assert (! (ListExp.inv4 5) :named _xkassert10))
(assert (! (ListExp.inv4 6) :named _xkassert11))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun ListExp.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or (deref-isa-Atom (ListExp!rightExp this)) (deref-isa-ListExp (ListExp!rightExp this)))
)

(assert (! (ListExp.inv5 5) :named _xkassert12))
(assert (! (ListExp.inv5 6) :named _xkassert13))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store(store(store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-S_Exp const-1-S_Exp))
        2 (lift-S_Exp const-2-S_Exp))
        3 (lift-Atom const-3-Atom))
        4 (lift-Atom const-4-Atom))
        5 (lift-ListExp const-5-ListExp))
        6 (lift-ListExp const-6-ListExp))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-2-S_Exp () S_Exp
  (mk-S_Exp ".(A.B))"))
(define-fun const-3-Atom () Atom
  (mk-Atom "A"))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 6))
(define-fun const-1-S_Exp () S_Exp
  (mk-S_Exp ".(A.B))"))
(define-fun const-5-ListExp () ListExp
  (mk-ListExp "((A.B).(A.B))" 6 6))
(define-fun const-4-Atom () Atom
  (mk-Atom "B"))
(define-fun const-6-ListExp () ListExp
  (mk-ListExp "(A.B)" 3 4))
(define-fun _xkassert7 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (rightExp (sel-ListExp (select heap 6))))))
  (or (is-lift-S_Exp a!1) (is-lift-Atom a!1) (is-lift-ListExp a!1))))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (str.contains (text (sel-Atom (select heap 3))) "("))
      (a!2 (str.contains (text (sel-Atom (select heap 3))) ")"))
      (a!3 (str.contains (text (sel-Atom (select heap 3))) ".")))
  (and (not a!1) (not a!2) (not a!3))))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (leftExp (sel-ListExp (select heap 6))))))
  (or (is-lift-S_Exp a!1) (is-lift-Atom a!1) (is-lift-ListExp a!1))))
(define-fun _xkassert13 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (rightExp (sel-ListExp (select heap 6))))))
  (or (is-lift-Atom a!1) (is-lift-ListExp a!1))))
(define-fun _xkassert9 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (leftExp (sel-ListExp (select heap 6)))))
      (a!3 (select heap (rightExp (sel-ListExp (select heap 6))))))
(let ((a!2 (ite (is-lift-S_Exp a!1)
                (text (sel-S_Exp a!1))
                (ite (is-lift-Atom a!1)
                     (text (sel-Atom a!1))
                     (text (sel-ListExp a!1)))))
      (a!4 (ite (is-lift-S_Exp a!3)
                (text (sel-S_Exp a!3))
                (ite (is-lift-Atom a!3)
                     (text (sel-Atom a!3))
                     (text (sel-ListExp a!3))))))
  (= (text (sel-ListExp (select heap 6))) (str.++ "(" a!2 "." a!4 ")")))))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (myList (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-ListExp a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert8 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (leftExp (sel-ListExp (select heap 5)))))
      (a!3 (select heap (rightExp (sel-ListExp (select heap 5))))))
(let ((a!2 (ite (is-lift-S_Exp a!1)
                (text (sel-S_Exp a!1))
                (ite (is-lift-Atom a!1)
                     (text (sel-Atom a!1))
                     (text (sel-ListExp a!1)))))
      (a!4 (ite (is-lift-S_Exp a!3)
                (text (sel-S_Exp a!3))
                (ite (is-lift-Atom a!3)
                     (text (sel-Atom a!3))
                     (text (sel-ListExp a!3))))))
  (= (text (sel-ListExp (select heap 5))) (str.++ "(" a!2 "." a!4 ")")))))
(define-fun _xkassert10 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (leftExp (sel-ListExp (select heap 5))))))
  (or (is-lift-Atom a!1) (is-lift-ListExp a!1))))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (str.contains (text (sel-Atom (select heap 4))) "("))
      (a!2 (str.contains (text (sel-Atom (select heap 4))) ")"))
      (a!3 (str.contains (text (sel-Atom (select heap 4))) ".")))
  (and (not a!1) (not a!2) (not a!3))))
(define-fun _xkassert12 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (rightExp (sel-ListExp (select heap 5))))))
  (or (is-lift-Atom a!1) (is-lift-ListExp a!1))))
(define-fun _xkassert11 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (leftExp (sel-ListExp (select heap 6))))))
  (or (is-lift-Atom a!1) (is-lift-ListExp a!1))))
(define-fun _xkassert6 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (rightExp (sel-ListExp (select heap 5))))))
  (or (is-lift-S_Exp a!1) (is-lift-Atom a!1) (is-lift-ListExp a!1))))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (myList (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (= (text (sel-ListExp a!1)) "(A.B)")))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (leftExp (sel-ListExp (select heap 5))))))
  (or (is-lift-S_Exp a!1) (is-lift-Atom a!1) (is-lift-ListExp a!1))))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun k!heap_full!S_Exp () Bool
  true)
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
                         0
                         (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 6)))
                  1
                  (lift-S_Exp (mk-S_Exp ".(A.B))")))))
(let ((a!2 (store (store a!1 2 (lift-S_Exp (mk-S_Exp ".(A.B))")))
                  3
                  (lift-Atom (mk-Atom "A")))))
(let ((a!3 (store (store a!2 4 (lift-Atom (mk-Atom "B")))
                  5
                  (lift-ListExp (mk-ListExp "((A.B).(A.B))" 6 6)))))
  (store a!3 6 (lift-ListExp (mk-ListExp "(A.B)" 3 4)))))))
(define-fun k!heap_full!ListExp () Bool
  true)
(define-fun k!heap_full!Atom () Bool
  true)
